key_insight: A preprocessing mesh-adaptation tool refines hybrid unstructured meshes around immersed geometries to improve accuracy and efficiency for immersed boundary CFD.
engineering_relevance: This enables mixed body-fitted/immersed simulations for complex or changing geometries, including practical high-lift aerodynamic configurations.
method: Input: conforming hybrid background mesh with tetrahedra, hexahedra, prisms, and pyramids.
Adapt/refine the mesh locally around immersed bodies for IBM-ready CFD.
Tested with finite volume and DG solvers for Navier--Stokes/RANS flows.
evidence_signal: The adapted meshes were evaluated on cylinder, NACA0012, and multi-element airfoil cases, with reported results in good agreement with experiments.
watch_item: Performance depends on the quality and conformity of the initial hybrid mesh, and local refinement near immersed boundaries may add preprocessing complexity.
paper_title: Mesh Adaptation on Hybrid Unstructured Meshes for Immersed Boundary Methods
